chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Assistance is provided according to the measure of need.

key_terms.الْمَئُونَةِ: Need, cost of living, or expenses incurred by a person.
key_terms.الْمَعُونَةُ: Assistance, aid, or financial support provided to someone.

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic principle regarding the distribution of financial assistance based on need?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the principle that material assistance (ma'unah) must be calibrated to the recipient's actual necessities (ma'unah), reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on proportional justice rather than uniform distribution. This maxim, found in Nahj al-Balagha, underscores the pragmatic application of economic equity, ensuring that support meets genuine need without excess or deficiency, a concept deeply rooted in Islamic jurisprudence regarding zakat and sadaqah.
